turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue in STE]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    AS3 --> AS4[This is a finding, not a draft]
    AS4 --> STOP1([Stop])

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> WAIT[Wait for answer]
    WAIT --> B

    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C{Floor check}
    C -->|Gaps| D{How many gaps?}
    D -->|Three or fewer| D1[Ask one question naming gaps]
    D -->|Four or more| D2[Ask three largest gaps]
    D2 --> D3[Assume the remaining gaps]
    D1 --> WAIT
    D3 --> WAIT

    C -->|Above floor| E[Compress prompt]
    E --> E1{Did the cut remove specification?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Name failure and revert]
    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No| E3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    E3 -->|Yes| F[Contract is minimal]
    E3 -->|No| E4{Does the floor still pass?}
    E4 -->|No| E5[Return last passing version]
    E5 --> F
    E4 -->|Yes| F

    F --> G[Output optimized prompt and cut]
    G --> H{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    H -->|Keep negotiating| E
    H -->|Freeze, execute, or run it from named human signer| I{Execution tools available?}
    I -->|No| J[Gate stays closed]
    I -->|Yes| K[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    K --> L{Result}
    L -->|Success| DONE([Done])
    L -->|Floor failure| N[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    N --> E
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: WAIT -> B, E2 -> E
